item.title: SM Home MEGA Warehouse Sale: Huge Discounts on Furniture, Décor & Essentials
item.description: The SM Home MEGA Warehouse Sale is back—and it’s bigger than ever! From February 27 to March 1, head to SM Megamall, Megatrade Halls 1 & 2 for the ultimate home shopping spree! Score unbeatable discounts and exclusive deals on furniture, décor, kitchenware, and more—everything you need to refresh your space in one MEGA event.

item.title: Century Seafood Restaurant 3rd Anniversary Promo: Special Discounts on Signature Dishes
item.description: Century Seafood Restaurant in Malate, Manila is celebrating its 3rd Anniversary with a feast of flavors and unbeatable deals. Indulge in signature dishes — like Xiaolong Pao, Peking Duck, and more — at special anniversary prices! Plus, enjoy 30% OFF dim sum lunch from Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Samgyupsalamat Day 3.3 Promo: Unlimited Pork K‑BBQ for ₱333 Nationwide
item.description: 🥩 Happy Samgyupsalamat Day! 🎉 Yes, March 3 is Samgyupsalamat Day! Every year, fans of Korean BBQ look forward to this nationwide promo and celebration of flavor, fun, and friendship.

item.title: Angel’s Pizza XL Slice Promo: March 3, 2026
item.description: 🍕 Double the XL Fun at Angel’s Pizza! One slice is never enough — so why not grab two? On March 3, 2026 only, Angel’s Pizza is serving up a deal that’s perfect for sharing (or keeping all to yourself).

item.title: #SpotYourHappy: Double the Happiness with Krispy Kreme Beverage Promos!
item.description: Coffee + doughnuts = happiness, but coffee + doughnuts + savings = next‑level happiness! 🥤🍩Mondays just got a major glow‑up, and your everyday coffee runs are about to taste sweeter too! 🥤🍩 Krispy Kreme is rolling out not one, but two awesome ways to #SpotYourHappy this 2026.

item.title: Cebu Pacific Celebrates 30 Years with Flights for as Low as ₱30 #CEBSuperSeatFest
item.description: ✈️💛 Cebu Pacific Turns 30 — Fly for as Low as ₱30! Thirty years of journeys, memories, and every Juan’s dreams taking flight! As a way of saying a BIG “thank you” for three decades of trust, Cebu Pacific is celebrating with the 30th Anniversary #CEBSuperSeatFest.

item.title: PAL 85th Anniversary Seat Sale – Exclusive Fares to the Philippines & Beyond (Book until March 15, 2026)
item.description: ✈️ PAL Turns 85! Celebrate with PAL's Anniversary Seat Sale! PAL is turning 85 — and the celebration is sky‑high! ✈️ With PAL's Anniversary Seat Sale, you can book exclusive fares (as low as P85) to your favorite destinations in the Philippines and around the world. Whether it’s a summer getaway, a reunion, or your dream adventure abroad, PAL has you covered with special fares across domestic and international routes.

item.title: Unlimited Dimsum Promo at Binondo Boys: ₱488+ Heavy Lunch Deal
item.description: 🥢 Unlimited Dimsum at Binondo Boys!Dimsum lovers, rejoice! Binondo Boys is serving up an irresistible deal that’s perfect for your midday cravings. Enjoy unlimited dim sum for only ₱488+ at Binondo Boys Diliman branch on 37 Sct. Torillo St., Quezon City.

item.title: Dairy Queen Summer Treats – Mini Blizzards for ₱49 (March 2–6, 2026)
item.description: ☀️🍦 Beat the Heat with Dairy Queen! Turn the rising heat into the perfect excuse to treat yourself. There’s no better time to stay cool than with Dairy Queen’s Mini Classic Blizzards — Oreo®, Strawberry, or Mango — for only ₱49 each.

item.title: Where have we seen Single’s Inferno star Choi Mina Sue before?
item.description: As viewers around the world tune in to Netflix’s Single’s Inferno, one face feels strikingly familiar.Choi Mina Sue—the elegant Miss Earth 2022 titleholder, and the first ever Korean to hold gain that crown—may be captivating audiences once again, but many have seen her long before the reality show spotlight.
